capabilities: Show word, character and reading-time counts in the status bar as you type
Count words, characters, sentences, lines and reading time in a counter panel
Track characters against social media and SEO limits with progress bars
Copy a counts-and-limits summary to the clipboard
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README ends by promoting the author's other free online tools.
intentEvidence: Live word, character and reading-time counts for the open note or the selected text, with the character limits
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count does not show detailed counts or tell you whether text fits platform-specific character limits like X posts or meta descriptions.

relations.evidence: The counting rules are the same as the free online GoSaveTool character counter

summary: Text counter that shows live word, character and reading-time counts with social media and SEO character limits for the note or selection.
